items.title: Group cohomology of modules with continuous action agrees with that of the underlying modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the diagram comparing the group cohomology of R-G-modules with that of their underlying G-modules commutes in every degree (statement lines 8857-8870, with the Xy-pic diagram delivered verbatim). The proof introduces the forgetful functor and compares the two cohomology functors through injective resolutions, using the companion result that an injective R-G-module is injective as a G-module (proof lines 8872-8903). The non-formal content is the comparison of the resolutions in the two categories. The claim is H2: one reduction to resolutions plus one companion input.
